description: <p>At Abnormal AI, we protect our customers against nefarious adversaries who are constantly evolving their techniques and tactics to outwit and undermine the traditional approaches to Security.&nbsp;</p> <p>Abnormal is recognized as a top cybersecurity startup (Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Email Security Platforms), securing a Series D funding of $250 million at a $5.1 billion valuation in August 2024.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About The Team&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The team is responsible for the ownership, development, and operation of the infrastructure and ML models, customer facing APIs and internal tools that drive Abnormal's Account Takeover (ATO) protection product. This product is crucial for detecting malicious activity and safeguarding customers from account theft.</p> <p><strong>About The Role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to take ownership of complex feature delivery and technical design for our ATO platform. This pivotal role involves evolving the platform to scale with expanding product requirements. The position requires a blend of hands-on backend systems development, production ownership, stakeholder management, and team mentorship. The core goal is to enhance system reliability, reduce latency, and significantly accelerate feature release cycles.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <h4><strong>Technical Delivery &amp; Excellence</strong></h4> <ul> <ul> <li>Design, build, and iterate on scalable backend and ML systems, APIs, frameworks, and internal tools&nbsp;</li> <li>Own end-to-end delivery of complex features that directly impact customer experience.</li> <li>Ensure stability, reliability, and operational excellence of critical systems.</li> <li>Write clean, testable, and resilient code with attention to edge cases and performance.</li> <li>Write and review technical design documents and influence adoption across the team.</li> <li>Participate in code and design reviews, and contribute to on-call rotations.</li> </ul> </ul> <h4><strong>Leadership &amp; Collaboration</strong></h4> <ul> <ul> <li>Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to align on specifications and priorities.</li> <li>Break down complex projects into clear executable steps and drive them to completion.</li> <li>Actively contribute to roadmap discussions and propose long-term technical plans.</li> <li>Communicate effectively in an async-first environment, providing clarity on updates, challenges, and solutions.</li> <li>Mentor peers, share knowledge, and influence engineering practices across the team.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Ownership &amp; Growth:</strong> A senior engineer mindset—able to independently lead complex projects and grow into a technical leader within the team.</li> <li><strong>Attention to Detail</strong>: Deep focus on code quality, reliability, monitoring, and performance.</li> <li><strong>System Thinker</strong>: Ability to anticipate long-term scaling needs and design resilient architectures.</li> <li><strong>Strong Collaborator:</strong> Comfortable influencing cross-team goals, mentoring peers, and working in a distributed environment.</li> <li><strong>GenAI Affinity:</strong> Proactive in leveraging modern developer productivity tools, including GenAI assistants, to accelerate delivery.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Must-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of industry experience, with proven expertise as a Senior Software Engineer.</li> <li>Strong backend proficiency in Python, with experience designing and scaling production systems.</li> <li>Proven experience with large scale system design, building resilient, scalable, and fault-tolerant applications.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of relational databases and modern data storage technologies .</li> <li>Familiarity with service-to-service communication (gRPC, Kafka) and caching (Redis).</li> <li>Experience with AWS cloud services (S3, RDS) and deployment practices.<br>Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm).</li> <li>Strong understanding of service health, monitoring, and incident response practices.</li> <li>Experience writing technical design documents and influencing adoption across teams.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-NT1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>A note on AI in our process:&nbsp;<br></strong>Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.</p> <p>Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please <a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt3a076cfd9753fa1f/blt9cbda641db7c0045/6a1e3d3a66aea075cd33e462/AAP_and_EEO_Statement.pdf" target="_blank"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><em>click here</em></span></a>. If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please&nbsp;<em><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt3a076cfd9753fa1f/blt4eb3a265cc7b1ca9/6a1e3d3bfe33e73c16ff026b/EEOC_Know_Your_Rights_Oct_30_2025.pdf" target="_blank">click here</a></span></em>.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

As well as&nbsp;<a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and&nbsp;<a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us.&nbsp;</p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>📍London / UK Remote | 💰 <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-0.pdf">Staff Backend Engineer (L60)</a> £130,000 - £170,000 + Equity&nbsp;+ <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>&nbsp;|&nbsp;<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology">Technology</a>&nbsp;- Engineering&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About our Engineering Teams:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We have around 650 engineers out of roughly 5,500 people in total - and we have big ambitions. There are many interesting challenges ahead, and we're happy for people to move between teams or to specialise, whatever you prefer. As an engineer here you'd be able to work directly with anyone across the company, and we run regular knowledge-sharing sessions so you’ll learn heaps about everything from how banks work to effective communication.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We contribute to </span><a href="https://github.com/monzo"><strong>open source software</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> as much as possible. Our </span><a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology"><strong>blog</strong></a><strong> </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">is a good place to learn even more about what we do!</span></p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="http://golang.org/"><strong>Go</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial </span><a href="https://www.envoyproxy.io/"><strong>Envoy Proxy</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> for RPC</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a infrastructure</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="https://facebook.github.io/react/"><strong>React</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> for internal web dashboards</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">We also have two physical datacenter sites with actual cables to connect to various third parties</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Your day-to-day&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This role is all about collaborating across disciplines to test hypotheses and make a difference to customers. As a product backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more!&nbsp;</span></p> <p>Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). Our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront - from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.</span></p> <p><strong>How we work 💻</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations &amp; Flexible Working:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.&nbsp;</p> <p>We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches &amp; treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p><strong>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're on the look out for L60 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our<a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-1.pdf">&nbsp;Engineering Progression Framework</a> we are also hiring on L40 &amp; L50, our interview process will determine your levelling.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>The Interview Process:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our interview process involves three main stages:&nbsp;</span></p> <ol> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Initial Call&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Take home task or pair coding exercise&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Final interview including a system design and a behavioural interview&nbsp;</span></li> </ol> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our average process takes around 2-3 weeks but we will always work around your availability.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see </span><a href="https://monzo.com/blog/2022/03/23/demystifying-the-backend-engineering-interview-process"><strong>here</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">.</span></p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">💰 £130,000 - £170,000 + Equity</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">✈️We can help you relocate to the UK&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">✅ We can sponsor visas.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">📍This role can be based in our London office or remotely across the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">📚</span><span style="font-weight: 400;">Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">➕And much more, see our full list of benefits </span><a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here&nbsp;</strong></a></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're usually always hiring We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.</p> <p>These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. You'll report to our CFO and work very closely with our CTO, as well as with the engineering team, operations and go-to-market. This is a hands-on role.   • Keep contracts, documents and policies consistent across geographies

  • Make the experience good for employees and managers, not just compliant

title: Développeur Python IA
description: Développeur Python IA (H/F) Paris/Lille | Secteur Assurance Pourquoi cette opportunité ? Parce que vous participerez à la construction de notre stratégie d’intelligence artificielle, que nous sommes en train de définir. Vous rejoindrez une équipe motivée et talentueuse, dont la mission est d’intégrer l’IA au cœur de nos processus métier. L’objectif est de répondre aux besoins de nos équipes comme à ceux de nos clients, et d’automatiser certaines tâches à faible valeur ajoutée. Éléments clés Concevoir des solutions RAG et agentiques appliquées à des cas d’usage métier concrets. Développer et orchestrer des agents tout en assurant la traçabilité des sources et la maîtrise des hallucinations. Contribuer directement au workflow de paramétrage produit KELIA, avec une validation humaine intégrée aux étapes clés. Participer à la mise en production des assistants, de leur API jusqu’à leur intégration dans l’interface web interne. Ce qu’il faut savoir : Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur Python IA pour rejoindre notre équipe R&D à Paris ou Lille Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des solutions, de la conception jusqu’à la mise en production, en mobilisant différentes approches : modèles de langage (LLM), apprentissage supervisé, clustering et autres techniques de machine Learning. Un volet important de la mission concerne également le paramétrage produit : l’objectif est d’extraire les informations pertinentes des conditions générales, de proposer un paramétrage, de prévoir une validation par un expert à chaque étape et de produire un fichier directement importable dans KELIA. Missions principales : Vous développez en Python des fonctionnalités IA. Ingestion documentaire : extraire le texte et les tableaux des PDF, des pages Confluence, des documents SharePoint et des dépôts GitLab, puis découper, indexer et mettre à jour ces contenus avec des jobs asynchrones. Recherche : recherche hybride (sémantique et mots-clés), filtres par collection et par chemin, reranking, et recherche visuelle sur les pages de documents. Agents et LLM : développer des agents avec LangGraph (routage, recherche, filtrage, réflexion, réponse), écrire et versionner les prompts, citer les sources, et répondre « je ne trouve pas » quand l'information manque. Workflow de paramétrage produit : contribuer à l'agent qui extrait les informations des conditions générales, propose le paramétrage, fait valider chaque étape par un expert et produit un fichier importable dans KELIA. Qualité : maintenir des jeux de tests, mesurer le taux de bonnes réponses, suivre les réponses inventées et vérifier que les résultats sont stables d'un run à l'autre. Coût et latence : suivre la consommation de tokens, le temps de première réponse et le cache, et choisir le bon modèle pour chaque tâche. API : exposer les assistants en API, avec des réponses en streaming, et les intégrer à l'interface web interne. Documenter votre code, écrire des tests et participer aux revues de code. Ce poste est fait pour vous si: Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’un Bac+5 en informatique ou assurance Vous maîtrisez Python 3.11+ et êtes à l’aise avec le développement d’API via FastAPI , Pydantic et le streaming SSE . Vous avez une expérience ou un réel intérêt pour les solutions d’ IA générative , les LLM et les architectures agentiques avec LangChain , LangGraph et LiteLLM . Vous connaissez les principes de RAG , de recherche hybride, d’embeddings et de reranking, idéalement avec Qdrant . Vous savez travailler avec des sources documentaires variées et leur ingestion, notamment des PDF , Confluence , SharePoint ou GitLab , avec des outils tels que Docling . Vous êtes à l’aise avec les environnements de stockage et de persistance reposant sur PostgreSQL et le stockage objet S3 . Vous accordez de l’importance à l’observabilité et à la qualité des solutions IA, notamment au suivi des prompts, des traces, des logs, des coûts et des performances, avec des outils comme MLflow . Vous êtes sensibilisé aux enjeux de sécurité, d’authentification et de gestion des rôles, notamment avec Keycloak . Vous évoluez avec aisance dans un environnement d’industrialisation moderne utilisant Git , GitLab CI , Docker , Kubernetes , Helm et pytest , ainsi que des outils collaboratifs comme Jira et Confluence . Ce que vous apportez Une bonne maîtrise de Python et de ses bonnes pratiques : tests (pytest), typage, gestion des dépendances. Votre expérience dans l’utilisation des API de LLM et bases du prompt engineering, y compris les sorties structurées. Votre compréhension du fonctionnement d'un RAG : embeddings, découpage, recherche, génération. Une bonne maîtrise du SQL et notions de bases de données. Git et travail en équipe. Pourquoi nous joindre: Pour contribuer à une stratégie où l’intelligence artificielle est un levier clé de la feuille de route technologique, avec des solutions intégrées au cœur des outils métiers. Pour travailler sur des cas d’usage concrets d’IA générative, de RAG et d’agents LLM, de l’expérimentation jusqu’à l’industrialisation. Pour associer des technologies IA de pointe à une expertise métier forte dans le secteur de l’assurance et créer des solutions à impact réel. Prêt(e) à démarrer une nouvelle expérience ? title: Embedded Linux Engineer (Yocto Specialist)
description: About Genesis Genesis is a physical AI lab and full-stack robotics company building general-purpose robots, with teams in Paris and the Bay Area. Our people have built some of the most widely used platforms in robotics research including the open-source Genesis simulator, pioneered generative simulation and led foundation-model work at some of the world's leading AI labs. We own the whole stack: hardware, embedded systems, simulation, data and robot foundation models. The Role Every Genesis robot runs on a custom jetson thor compute board and every piece of software we write: control, perception, learned policies, depends on the Linux image underneath it. We are looking for a senior engineer to own that image end to end: build it, ship it to the robot, keep it updatable, and make it easy for the rest of the team to compile and deploy on top of it. This is an in-house ownership role. You will be the reference for embedded Linux at Genesis, working closely with our embedded, robotics and application-software engineers in Paris and with our hardware partners. The job is to provide a reliable, well maintained and up to date os image, customized to our needs. What You'll Do Build, own and maintain the production Yocto/OpenEmbedded distribution for our robot's custom board: BSP, kernel, device tree, rootfs, toolchain and custom layers. Bring up new hardware on NVIDIA Jetson-class platforms, integrating drivers and peripherals. Including hands-on debugging of components such as Wi-Fi, cameras, audio devices and buses on the physical robot. Own the full image lifecycle: reproducible builds, versioned releases, secure and robust over-the-air (OTA) updates, and long-term maintenance as hardware and software evolve. Deliver a development kit and workflow (SDK, cross-compilation, deployment tooling) so engineers can build and ship their software onto the robot quickly. Integrate GPU and AI-accelerator inference stacks so that our models run efficiently on the robot. Speed up the team's build and CI pipeline for image generation and validation. Builds are long, so caching and automation matter, as well as removing unnecessary dependencies. Document the system and make it approachable, so the image is never again a black box that only one person (or contractor) understands. Your First Three Months Build a custom Yocto image for the robot's custom boards. Flash, boot and validate it on real hardware, working through driver and integration issues on-site. Set up the cross compilation workflow, caching, CI automations to streamline the robotics team work What You'll Bring Passion for your craft and demonstrated excellence in embedded Linux engineering. 5+ years of hands-on embedded Linux experience, including shipping at least one Yocto-based image to production not only a prototype. Proven ownership of an image through its lifecycle: maintenance, release management and remote/OTA updates. Deep experience with Yocto internals: layers, recipes, BitBake, machine and distro configuration, SDK generation. Strong board bring-up and low-level debugging skills: kernel configuration, device trees, drivers, boot chain. raw.title: Genesis-World: Core Simulation Engine Engineer
raw.description:
What we’re building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

This is at the core of Genesis AI’s strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

Simulation is still a hard sell in robotics. Outside a few success stories, like reinforcement learning for locomotion, most teams skip it, and friction is a big part of why: painful to use, painful to debug. We live that pain ourselves: debugging a failing experiment during policy evaluation takes 30 minutes, and there is no way to automatically generate a standalone reproduction script. That blocks adoption, even internally.

Your job is to kill that friction. You build the software engineering backbone of Genesis-World: everything that makes a large, fast-moving simulation codebase reliable, maintainable, frictionless. And it all ships in the open. Every hour of pain you remove, you remove for every roboticist who comes after you.

You join as core maintainer of Genesis-World, with shared stewardship of the whole platform from day one. Our physics team develops the algorithms, but just as importantly, you work to make everything around them excellent: infrastructure, tooling, APIs, architecture.

The problems waiting for you

  • Make testing of a JIT-compiled engine scalable. Running our full suite is already taking hours because the ratio between compile time and runtime can be as bad as x10. Getting rid of this bottleneck is a serious challenge that will require a joint effort from the Genesis-World and the compiler teams.

  • Make any bug reproducible. Dump and reload simulations bit-exactly, across machines, across backends, even when a single timestep of a batched simulation can already max out VRAM. Turn any failing run into a standalone reproduction script, automatically.

  • Make autodiff first-class. Genesis-World is differentiable today, but partially: memory-hungry, slower than it could be, and hard to maintain due to manual operation recording. The project spans the engine and the compiler: you drive the requirements on Quadrants and iterate in a tight loop with the compiler team until the integration is solid.

  • Edit scenes at frozen time. See the scene, move entities and robots around, iterate on layout, all without building the scene or compiling the engine. Authoring today means a full build cycle. Make it instant.

  • Make the simulator extensible. First-class plugins for physics solvers and interactive viewer backends, including Nyx. Sensors already work this way. Generalize it, and Genesis-World becomes a platform others build on.

  • Give robots real actuation. Motors and MIMO transmissions, cleanly abstracted at the interface between users and the physics engine.

  • Make time a local variable. Today the clock and the timestep are global to the engine, which forbids whole classes of speedups: environments cannot step independently, the timestep cannot adapt to the state, and individual solvers cannot advance at their own rate. Free the clock down to the sub-scene level and let the simulation fly.

  • Make scenes come alive. Events triggered by physics: press the button and the microwave door pops open, squeeze the trigger and the drill spins.

  • Keep the core sharp. Refactoring legacy subsystems, stronger typing, consistent coding style, less Python overhead on hot paths, full scene serialization, telemetry and replay.

Beyond the code: you review issues and pull requests with the core team, answer questions from users and contributors, and can join the push on adoption.

Who you are

You care about the engineer using what you build as much as the thing itself. A slow test, a cryptic error, a manual step: you see it, you go after the root cause, and you remove it for everyone. You have opinions about API design.

You are comfortable with physics and robotics: the right design choices take a working picture of what a simulator like Genesis-World does, how it works, and how it is used, a picture you can partly build on the job.

  • Strong Python engineering on large codebases: architecture, refactoring, typing, packaging, performance profiling (py-spy, Nsight, Xcode Instruments, RenderDoc).

  • Developer tooling, test infrastructure, or CI at scale.

  • Enough fluency with JIT compilation, code generation, or GPU computing stacks to reason about compilation caching, kernel dispatch, and startup cost. You will work closely with Quadrants.

  • At ease debugging across the full platform matrix: Windows, Linux, and macOS, on x86 and arm64, over CUDA, AMD, and Apple Metal (and possibly Intel XPU via Vulkan soon)

  • Open-source reflexes: triaging issues, reviewing external pull requests, communicating with a community.

Bonus points: experience with other robotics simulators (Drake, MuJoCo, Newton, Isaac, RaiSim, Jiminy, Brax). PyTorch, our user-facing interface. Other JIT compilers such as Triton, JAX, or Numba. 3D tooling and interactive editors (Maya, Blender, Houdini). Serialization formats (USD, glTF, MJCF/URDF). C++, CUDA, or Metal. Developer relations or community work.

raw.title: Senior Quantum Optics Scientist - Spin-Based Quantum Systems
raw.description:
- About Quandela:

Quandela is a European deeptech scale-up developing modular, scalable and energy-efficient photonic and spin-optical quantum computers, accessible through the cloud and on-premises.

With over 140 employees, we develop our own hardware and software stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to quantum control systems and algorithms.

Our ambition is to build large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers, combining quantum dot technologies, scalable spin-photon interfaces and distributed entanglement within future Spin-Optical Quantum Computing (SPOQC) architectures.

- About this position:

You will join Quandela's Semiconductor Optics Team, bringing together expertise in quantum optics, spin physics, semiconductor technologies and quantum information.

Your focus will be to develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols, improve spin coherence and operation fidelity, and advance optical control techniques for future hybrid quantum computing architectures.

We are looking for an experienced experimental scientist who can independently drive complex experimental activities, shape technical directions and translate scientific results into reliable technological building blocks, working closely with our research and engineering teams.

With several experimental building blocks still under development, you'll have room to shape technical choices, tackle open scientific challenges and directly influence our technology roadmap.

- What you'll do:

Spin-based quantum experiments

  • Design, develop and optimize optical experiments involving spin-photon sources.
  • Implement optical control schemes for spin initialization, readout and manipulation.
  • Characterize spin coherence, operation fidelity and entanglement quality.

Scientific and experimental ownership

  • Independently drive experimental investigations, from design to validation.
  • Structure and prioritize scientific activities, milestones and technical challenges.
  • Troubleshoot complex experimental systems and propose technical improvements.
  • Share expertise and support less experienced colleagues when relevant.

Technology development and integration

  • Develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols.
  • Collaborate with theory, electronics and semiconductor technology teams.
  • Improve experimental robustness, reproducibility and system performance.
  • Translate scientific results into demonstrators and technological building blocks for future multi-spin architectures.

- How You Will Grow:

During your first 3 months 
You will become familiar with Quandela's experimental platforms and ongoing demonstrators, contributing your expertise to current technical challenges.

Within 6 months 
You will drive dedicated experimental workstreams, contribute to key technical decisions and strengthen theory-to-experiment feedback loops.

Within 1 year 
You will help shape the team's experimental direction, advance distributed entanglement demonstrations and contribute to future spin-based architectures.

Requirements

- What we're looking for

We are looking for an experienced experimental researcher combining strong scientific expertise, technical autonomy and the ability to drive complex research activities.

Must-have

  • PhD in Spin Physics, Quantum Optics or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience with spin-based quantum systems (control, readout or coherence measurements).
  • Proven autonomy in designing, optimizing and troubleshooting complex quantum experiments.
  • Strong understanding of quantum optics, spin coherence and experimental measurement techniques.
  • Ability to lead scientific activities and make independent technical decisions.
  • Comfortable collaborating across experimental, theory and engineering teams

Important, but you can grow here

  • Photon-mediated entanglement protocols and multi-spin architectures.
  • Semiconductor quantum emitters, quantum dots and spin-photon interfaces.
  • Advanced optical control, cryogenic platforms and fast electronics.
  • Experimental qualification, system integration and technology transfer.

Bonus points

  • Experience bridging academic research and industrial R&D.
  • Experience coordinating scientific projects or mentoring researchers.

- Career Stage & Team Contribution: 

We primarily target candidates with a PhD and 4+ years of postdoctoral or equivalent R&D experience, combining scientific expertise with strong experimental autonomy.

Researchers completing a substantial postdoc are also welcome if they demonstrate scientific maturity, technical ownership and readiness for broader responsibilities.

People management experience is not required. What matters is your ability to drive scientific activities, tackle complex technical challenges and share your expertise with the team.

Benefits

  • Profit-sharing and a company savings plan. 
  • Public transport subscription covered at 50%. 
  • Annual sustainable mobility bonus for eco-friendly transport (e-bike, electric car). 
  • Fully covered health insurance (Alan). 
  • Referral program (€1,000 for a junior and €2,000 for an experienced candidate). 
  • Access to a nursery via choisir-ma-creche or contribution to childcare expenses. 
  • Subsidy for gym membership and sports activities (Gymlib). 
  • Meal subsidies (Swile). 

 Localisation of the position : Based at the IPVF campus in Palaiseau, within the Paris-Saclay research ecosystem. 

Process: 

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30–45 min)
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45–60 min)
  • Technical discussion and presentation of previous research work
  • Meeting with the team and scientific discussion
  • Reference checks
  • Offer

- Beyond That

At Quandela, you'll work on challenging scientific questions while helping turn experimental advances into technologies for future quantum computers.

Our spin-based platforms are still evolving, leaving room to explore new approaches, influence technical directions and take real ownership of experimental challenges.

If you're excited by the idea of combining ambitious quantum research with tangible technological impact, we'd love to hear from you, even if your background doesn't match every requirement.

raw.description:
Join us as an AI Engineer in our AI Products team to make sure the AI agents we ship are as reliable as they are fast to build. You'll design the evals, observability and tooling that keep agent quality high in a regulated bank.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Build agents: You'll develop agents that take real actions for customers.

  • Match rigor to risk: You'll size evaluation to the stakes, because an agent making transfers is not a PR bot.

  • Own evaluation of every feature: You'll make sure every new agent capability comes with the right evaluation strategy, defining what needs to be tested offline and validated online, based on business requirements, expected outcomes and risk.

  • Observe agents in production: You'll build the monitoring strategy that makes agent behaviour visible, tracks performance against business objectives and flags issues early.

  • Scale it as a platform: You'll turn our tools, evaluation practices and monitoring capabilities into a self-service platform that lets other teams build, evaluate and operate their own agents.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Evaluation mindset: You've evaluated models or LLM systems and know what makes a test misleading.

  • Strong ML foundations: You understand the ML lifecycle, from training and iteration to evaluation and monitoring, and core concepts such as overfitting, generalization and cross-validation.

  • LLM and agentic systems knowledge: You understand the fundamentals of LLMs (particularly the Transformer architecture) and the building blocks of agentic systems. You know how to optimize an agent's harness (prompts, tools, hooks and orchestration) to improve its reliability and performance.

  • Builder instinct and backend comfort: You've built and shipped something used by real users, whether professionally, during an internship or as a side project. You're comfortable reading and writing backend code, working with APIs and integrating systems.

  • AI-native curiosity: You follow developments in AI closely, experiment with new approaches on your own and use AI tools daily in your work.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A rare problem: You'll make AI agents trustworthy in a regulated bank, where quality is not optional.

  • Hands-on coaching: You'll learn directly from Pierre-Jean, one of the AI engineers in the team.

  • Room to grow: Your scope grows as the platform opens to more teams.

  • Space to experiment: You'll work at the frontier of AI in a team that keeps experimentation at its core.

  • Her background? Sophie has led product teams in startups and established tech companies.

title: GPU Engineer
description: About Kog At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents. Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act. Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs. We've developed several technologies to make this possible: Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs. KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency. Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading. Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach. Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution. Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released. Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today. These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results. We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually. This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it. Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai . What you'll work on You'll join our GPU engineering team to tackle challenging performance problems and help build the internal agents that will accelerate this work. Develop and optimize GPU kernels using C++, CUDA, HIP, and low-level instructions. Investigate GPU architecture, memory access, synchronization, and execution bottlenecks. Profile and benchmark workloads to identify and validate performance improvements. Optimize inference operations and communication across multiple GPUs. Implement and optimize new AI models on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs. Help build AI agents for GPU engineering , enabling automated code optimization, correctness testing, benchmarking, and iterative improvements. Take ownership of technical decisions and their implementation. Strong hands-on experience developing and optimizing GPU kernels, ideally using CUDA C++ or HIP/ROCm. Experience with PTX, CDNA ISA, multi-GPU systems, low-latency inference, or GPU performance portability is particularly valuable. About H

H exists to push the boundaries of superintelligence with agentic AI. By automating complex, multi-step tasks typically performed by humans, AI agents will help unlock full human potential.

H is hiring the world’s best AI talent, seeking those who are dedicated as much to building safely and responsibly as to advancing disruptive agentic capabilities. We promote a mindset of openness, learning, and collaboration, where everyone has something to contribute.

Your role

At H, Product Marketing is the expert on our customers and our market. It decides how H is positioned and differentiated, and makes our value obvious.

H Company is seeking a Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise to help our sales teams win and grow our largest customers. You will own the messaging, enablement and proof that make our enterprise offer easy to understand, easy to trust and easy to buy, in long sales cycles with engineers, business leaders and the C-suite around the table.

This role is ideal for a hands-on product marketer who loves being close to the field and excels at turning complex technology into stories that convert. You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Engineers, Product and Marketing to position H as the reference for AI agents in the enterprise.

What you will own

Voice of the customer

  • Capture field feedback (objections, lost deals) and competitive insights to keep our messaging grounded in what AI transformation leaders actually care about

  • Share insights with Product Marketing, Sales and Product to inform positioning and roadmap decisions

Positioning and messaging

  • Adapt our product messaging for each audience (C-level, technical leaders, operational managers), translating technical features into compelling, value-based stories

  • Build and maintain playbooks for our priority industries, use cases and personas

  • Provide key messages and content used in acquisition campaigns

Sales enablement

  • Build and maintain the sales kit (pitch deck, one-pagers, FAQ, battlecards, objection handling) for a sales team navigating long enterprise cycles

  • Stay close to deals: listen to calls, join key meetings and track which materials work and which don’t

  • Prepare Sales for model releases and product launches with materials and training

Proof and credibility

  • Produce customer case studies, success stories and testimonials with our Forward Deployed Engineers and customers, to equip Sales and Marketing

  • Run our analyst program: track and plan our participation, build and maintain a reusable answer library, and turn analyst recognition into GTM assets (one-pagers, website proof points, PR)

About you

An autonomous doer, comfortable close to the field, who knows how to move forward from an existing framework and make technical topics simple.

  • Experience: 3 to 5 years in product marketing, sales enablement or solutions marketing, ideally in B2B tech with complex sales cycles and enterprise sales teams

  • Environment: experience in fast-moving, international settings, ideally a startup, a scale-up or the AI sector

  • Storytelling: you understand technical products and translate them into business value, with polished materials and sharp copy

  • Cross-functional: you get things done with Sales, Product and RevOps

  • AI-driven productivity: you use AI tools to produce faster without sacrificing quality

  • Curiosity: you love new technologies

  • Languages: fluent in English and French, written and spoken

Location

  • Paris or London.

  • This role is hybrid, and you are expected to be in the office 3 days a week on average.

  • Please expect some travel between offices on a reasonable cadence (e.g., every 4-6 weeks).

What We Offer

  • Join the exciting journey of shaping the future of AI, and be part of the early days of one of the hottest AI startups

  • Collaborate with a fun, dynamic and multicultural team, working alongside world-class AI talent in a highly collaborative environment

  • Enjoy a competitive salary

  • Unlock opportunities for professional growth, continuous learning, and career development

If you want to change the status quo in AI, join us.

title: CFD Workflow Automation Intern
description: About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems. Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team! We are looking for a CFD Workflow Automation Intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse. About the role: We are seeking a highly skilled intern with a strong programming background and an interest in engineering simulation to help automate repetitive CFD activities across the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. The role will focus on developing robust, reusable workflows for meshing, simulation setup and launching, data extraction, post-processing, and standardized reporting, with particular emphasis on Cadence and Ansys Fluent environments. The internship is intended to reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and shorten analysis turnaround time across the Fluidics Department. The intern will work with engineers from both teams to identify high-value automation opportunities, translate existing engineering practices into scripts and workflows, and validate the resulting tools on representative analysis cases. Prior expertise in Cadence or Ansys Fluent is not required; strong programming ability and a willingness to learn the relevant engineering applications are more important. Key Responsibilities: • Develop scripts and utilities to automate CFD meshing, simulation setup, job launching, monitoring, and post-processing activities. • Automate recurring workflows in Cadence and Ansys Fluent, using the scripting and interface capabilities available within those environments. • Create reusable tools for data extraction, visualization, comparison, and standardized reporting of CFD results. • Work with the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team to streamline the design-analysis iteration loop, including comparison of CFD results with design intent. • Work with the Fluidic Analysis Team to identify repetitive analysis tasks and convert them into reliable, maintainable automated processes. • Define input requirements, verification checks, error handling, and user documentation so that the developed tools can be adopted by different engineers. • Validate automated workflows against existing manual processes and document accuracy, repeatability, limitations, and expected time savings. • Present progress and results to the participating teams and incorporate user feedback into successive tool improvements. What you need to be successful: • Final-year student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field. • Strong programming skills, preferably in Python; experience with additional scripting languages is an advantage. • Understanding of software development fundamentals, including modular code, version control, testing, debugging, and documentation. • Ability to analyse an existing manual workflow, identify repetitive steps, and translate the process into a structured automation solution. • Interest in CFD, numerical simulation, engineering data processing, or scientific computing. Previous application-specific experience is not mandatory. • Fluency in written and spoken English. Soft Skills: • Analytical and methodical approach to problem solving. • Proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of a defined work package. • Clear communication and ability to gather requirements from engineers in different teams. • Attention to detail, with a focus on reliability, traceability, and usability. • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a multicultural, multidisciplinary environment. Other useful skills: • Experience with engineering or scientific Python and Matlab libraries for data processing and visualization. • Familiarity with Linux, command-line tools, batch processing, high-performance computing, or job schedulers. • Exposure to APIs, graphical user interfaces, dashboards, or automated report generation. • Familiarity with Git or another version-control system. • Previous exposure to Cadence, Ansys Fluent, CFD meshing, or simulation postprocessing is beneficial but not required. • Basic knowledge of fluid dynamics or numerical methods is an advantage. Supervision and collaboration: The intern will be supervised by a designated engineer and will collaborate with representatives of both the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. The assignment will be managed as a shared departmental initiative, with priorities defined according to the automation needs and potential impact identified by the participating teams. Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization. Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace. More about us… We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values: Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals. Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions. Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement. Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values. Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals. If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you! Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: At Goodweek, we help businesses make the most of AI. Our international team is based across France, Spain, and the United States, and our vision is backed by six international investment funds. title: Content Creator – Gastronomie & Hospitality (H/F)
description: À propos de Culinary Agency Passionné(e) par la gastronomie, la création vidéo et les univers premium ? Vous souhaitez mettre votre créativité au service de belles maisons, de restaurants, d’hôtels et d’acteurs de la gastronomie ? Chez Culinary Agency , nous accompagnons des établissements et des marques d’exception dans leur stratégie de communication et leur présence sur les réseaux sociaux. Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité et de notre portefeuille clients, nous recherchons un(e) Content Creator capable d’imaginer, de produire et de monter des contenus visuels de qualité, avec un véritable sens du détail et de l’esthétique. Vos missions En lien étroit avec les équipes de l’agence et en binôme avec un Content Creator Junior, vous serez au cœur de la production de contenus pour nos clients. 1. Organisation et préparation des tournages Organiser et planifier les sessions de tournage chez nos clients. Préparer les besoins en amont : idées de contenus, séquences, matériel et organisation logistique. Veiller au bon déroulement des tournages et au respect des plannings. 2. Création de contenus vidéo Réaliser des prises de vue directement chez nos clients : restaurants, hôtels, chefs et maisons premium. Imaginer et produire des contenus adaptés aux codes des réseaux sociaux, notamment Instagram et les formats courts (Reels). Mettre en valeur les lieux, les équipes, les produits, les gestes et les expériences à travers un regard créatif et soigné. Être capable de produire un volume important de contenus tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité. Être présent(e) sur le terrain environ 3 à 4 jours par semaine pour réaliser les tournages chez nos clients. 3. Montage et post-production Assurer le montage des vidéos et leur adaptation aux différents formats. Sélectionner les meilleures séquences, travailler le rythme et soigner les détails visuels. Organiser et suivre les étapes de montage, en garantissant le respect des délais et des attentes clients. 4. Suivi, coordination et relation client Participer au suivi des stratégies de contenu définies pour les clients. Travailler en binôme avec le Content Creator Junior et coordonner les différentes étapes de production. Être force de proposition et contribuer à faire évoluer la qualité créative des contenus de l'agence. Développer une relation de confiance avec les clients, en étant leur interlocuteur privilégié lors des tournages et en assurant un suivi de qualité. Créer un lien humain fort avec les clients, comprendre leurs attentes et leurs univers, et savoir s'adapter à leurs personnalités. Représenter l'agence auprès de clients et de personnalités de premier plan, parfois connues, et contribuer à construire des relations professionnelles durables. La relation client est une dimension essentielle du poste : votre capacité à créer du lien, à instaurer la confiance et à faire vivre une expérience agréable à nos clients contribuera directement à la réussite des projets. Le profil que nous recherchons Nous recherchons avant tout une personne créative, organisée, rigoureuse et à l'aise sur le terrain , capable de passer rapidement d'un univers client à un autre. Vous vous reconnaissez dans les points suivants : Vous avez une expérience en création de contenu vidéo, tournage et montage. Vous maîtrisez la captation vidéo, notamment avec un iPhone, et connaissez les codes des réseaux sociaux. Vous possédez un véritable œil esthétique et savez identifier les images qui valorisent un lieu, un produit ou une expérience. Vous êtes extrêmement organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et capable de gérer plusieurs productions en parallèle. Vous savez produire du contenu en volume sans sacrifier la qualité. Vous avez un excellent relationnel et êtes à l'aise pour représenter l'agence auprès de clients exigeants. Vous aimez créer du lien, instaurer une relation de confiance et entretenir des relations professionnelles de qualité. Vous soignez votre présentation et adoptez une attitude professionnelle en toutes circonstances. Vous êtes polyvalent(e), autonome et capable de vous adapter à des environnements et des interlocuteurs variés. Une expérience à l'international est un vrai plus , tout comme une sensibilité particulière aux univers de la gastronomie, de l'hôtellerie haut de gamme, du luxe et de l'art de vivre. Ce que nous proposons Localisation : Paris, secteur Saint-Lazare et Paris-centre Présence terrain : environ 3 à 4 jours par semaine chez nos clients pour les tournages. Déplacements professionnels : environ 3 jours par mois , avec des nuitées à prévoir selon les tournages. Vous rejoindrez une agence en plein développement, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez participer à des projets variés, rencontrer de belles maisons et contribuer directement à la qualité des productions. Notre processus de recrutement Nous souhaitons prendre le temps de découvrir votre parcours, votre personnalité et votre potentiel créatif. Premier échange en visioconférence : un entretien de préqualification pour faire connaissance, comprendre votre parcours, vos expériences et vos motivations. Mise en situation : si ce premier échange est concluant, nous vous proposerons un exercice pratique afin d'évaluer votre créativité, votre sens de l'image, votre maîtrise de la vidéo et votre capacité à produire du contenu. Vérification des références : nous pourrons échanger avec certaines de vos précédentes expériences professionnelles. Entretien final avec le CEO : une dernière rencontre pour échanger sur votre vision du poste et votre envie de rejoindre Culinary Agency. Vous avez envie de mettre votre créativité au service de la gastronomie et de belles maisons ? Nous avons hâte de vous rencontrer et de vous accueillir dans notre brigade ! description: <p><strong>Présentation du poste :</strong></p> <p>Concevoir une architecture d’IA, c’est engager une entreprise pour plusieurs années : l’emplacement des données, la gestion des accès, la manière dont un agent passe en production sous le regard des équipes de sécurité. En France, vous rejoignez le département Engineering (environ 300 personnes, sous la responsabilité du CTO), au sein du chapter AI Architect.</p> <p><strong>Activités et responsabilités :</strong></p> <p>Sur un projet, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les AI Applied Engineers, qui construisent et font tourner ce que vous concevez, et avec les AI Product Managers, qui portent le produit avec le client.</p> <p>Côté client, deux publics sont à convaincre : les directions métier, avec lesquelles vous définissez la cible, et les équipes IT, sécurité, réseau et exploitation, sans l’adhésion desquelles rien ne passe en production. Les architectes qui réussissent chez nous sont, entre autres, des profils techniques passés par le conseil, des pre-sales engineers, des FDEs, ou des personnes avec une expérience en tant que CTO.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Les indispensables :</span></p> <ol> <li>Vous avez conçu une architecture data ou IA qui a été mise en production, et vous savez expliquer pourquoi vous avez écarté les autres options, techniques ou non.</li> <li>Vous avez déjà recommandé une option techniquement moins séduisante parce qu'elle correspondait mieux au budget, aux compétences, à la gouvernance ou à la réglementation du client.</li> <li>Vous maîtrisez au moins un grand cloud (Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS) ainsi que les fondamentaux de la sécurité et du réseau : IAM, gestion des secrets, architecture réseau.</li> <li>Vous avez rédigé des dossiers d’architecture (HLD et LLD) qui ont servi de base à une équipe de delivery.</li> <li>Vous avez codé pendant une partie significative de votre parcours. Aujourd'hui, vous savez lire du code, challenger un design et dire ce qu'exige un système en production : CI/CD, monitoring, gestion des incidents.</li> <li>Vous avez déjà cadré et chiffré une solution, par exemple pour une proposition commerciale ou un plan projet.</li> <li>Vous avez défendu une architecture à la fois devant une direction métier ou un comité de direction, et devant les équipes sécurité et exploitation, en reliant la valeur business, les choix techniques et le plan de delivery.</li> </ol> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Un plus, pas un prérequis :</span></p> <ul> <li>Architecture de plateformes agentiques : RAG, orchestration multi-agents, choix des technologies couche par couche.</li> <li>Gouvernance des données à l’échelle d’une grande entreprise : data mesh, gestion des accès.</li> <li>Plateformes on premise, hybrides ou souveraines, basées sur des technologies open source ou sur Kubernetes.</li> <li>Standards de run : SLA, PRA et PCA.</li> <li>Une expérience de CTO, de tech lead ou dans un rôle au contact des clients.</li> <li>Une certification d’architecture cloud.</li> <li>Une pratique régulière des coding agents.</li> </ul> <p>Ce poste n'est probablement pas pour vous si votre expertise porte sur une seule plateforme ou un seul éditeur et que vous souhaitez continuer à l'approfondir. title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
description: The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on. What you'll do Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence. Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it. Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims. Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions. Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why. What we're looking for You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi). You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing. Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans. You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale. Bonus Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies Information extraction or truth discovery at scale Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats Example projects Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months. Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes. Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest. Exa is an equal opportunity employer. Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com.

Our goal is for Rivia to become the new standard infrastructure for modern drug development, bringing new therapies to market more successfully at a fraction of the cost.

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on Head of Customer Success to lead and scale how Rivia delivers value to customers. As our first dedicated Customer Success leader, you will oversee the post-sales journey, from onboarding and technical implementation through adoption, retention, and long-term account growth.

You will lead Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering, build a repeatable operating model, and stay close to strategic biotech and pharmaceutical customers. You will combine scientific and technical credibility with strong people leadership, commercial judgment, and a builder’s mindset.

Ownership and Commercial Collaboration

Customer Success owns the post-sales customer relationship, implementation, adoption, measurable value realization, customer health, retention strategy, and renewal readiness. The They will be accountable for customer outcomes and for proactively identifying and developing expansion opportunities.

Sales owns the commercial pipeline and execution of renewal and upsell transactions, including commercial negotiations and closing. The Head of Customer Success partners closely with Sales to shape account strategies, quantify customer value, identify and qualify opportunities, manage renewal risks, and support successful commercial outcomes.


What excites you

  • Building something from the ground up. You're excited by the opportunity to shape and scale a Customer Success function, creating the structure, processes, and standards that will support Rivia's next stage of growth.

  • Making a real impact on drug development. You're motivated by working at the intersection of life sciences and technology, helping biotech companies make better decisions and accelerate clinical development.

  • Being close to customers. You enjoy understanding complex scientific and technical challenges, building trusted relationships, and translating customer needs into meaningful outcomes.

  • Combining leadership with hands-on execution. You love developing high-performing teams but are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves, solving difficult problems, and taking ownership of strategic accounts.

  • Driving measurable business impact. You're energized by improving customer retention, demonstrating value, and identifying opportunities to grow customer relationships in close partnership with Sales.

  • Thriving in a fast-paced environment. You enjoy autonomy, ambitious goals, and the opportunity to influence decisions directly, without waiting for someone else to tell you what to do.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and coach the Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering teams, setting clear standards for performance, development, capacity planning, and hiring.

  • Build and scale the end-to-end post-sales experience, including onboarding, implementation, technical delivery, success plans, executive business reviews, escalation management, and value realization.

  • Own customer health, adoption, retention strategy, and renewal readiness; partner with Sales on renewal and expansion planning and execution.

  • Oversee complex implementations, integration quality, delivery timelines, and smooth handoffs from Sales.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior scientific, technical, and business stakeholders at biotech and pharma customers.

  • Translate platform usage into measurable outcomes, including time saved, costs avoided, and operational improvements.

  • Define and monitor customer success metrics, including adoption, time to value, GRR, NRR, renewal performance, and expansion opportunities.

  • Resolve critical customer escalations and translate recurring feedback into priorities for Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales.

  • Introduce scalable account segmentation, coverage models, reporting, and operating rhythms without unnecessary bureaucracy.

What excites us:

  • Experience leading and developing customer-facing teams in a B2B technology environment, while remaining personally close to customers.

  • A background in life sciences, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, pharmaceutical development, or a closely related scientific field.

  • Experience with biotech, pharma, clinical development, scientific software, or other complex life-sciences technology customers.

  • Evidence of driving customer retention, renewals, adoption, and account expansion through cross-functional collaboration.

  • Strong understanding of SaaS economics and customer success metrics, including GRR, NRR, customer health, and renewal rates.

  • Ability to navigate technical implementations, manage executive escalations, and influence senior stakeholders.

  • A structured, hands-on leadership style, commercial judgment, direct communication, and urgency in a fast-moving environment.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience building a Customer Success function at an early-stage or Series A company.

  • Deep familiarity with clinical trials, clinical data, or pharmaceutical R&D workflows.

  • Experience supporting strategic expansion in enterprise biotech or pharmaceutical accounts.

  • A track record of measurable improvements in retention, adoption, and customer outcomes.

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team.

  • In it to Win it: Approach challenges with determination, resilience, and drive.

  • Embrace change: See change as an opportunity to improve.

  • Why not?: Challenge assumptions and stay curious.

  • Find the gap: Proactively identify and solve problems.

  • Collective accountability: Own outcomes together and support one another.

  • Value add solutions: Deliver meaningful, impactful results.

title: Head of AI
description: About Poesis Whoever builds the leading intelligence for finance will create far more than returns. Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal. About the Role Financial markets offer something rare in AI research: a continuous, objective feedback loop where you can test new ideas, measure whether they actually work, and use real-world outcomes to inform what you build next. It’s an opportunity to do frontier research with a direct line between the ideas you explore and their real-world performance. As Head of AI, you’ll lead Poesis’s AI strategy and research, setting the technical direction for how we apply frontier AI to investing. You’ll explore new AI approaches, tackle difficult research problems and help define how we use AI to better understand and predict financial markets. This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll set the research agenda while continuing to work directly on technical challenges. Challenges You’ll Work On Set Poesis’s AI research direction, identify the hardest problems worth solving and guide the team's technical work. Push the capabilities of foundation models, agentic systems and world models through new architectures and research approaches. Explore pre-training, mid-training and post-training methods to improve how models learn, reason and adapt. Advance tabular ML research, including emerging methods such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs). Tackle the challenges of learning from small, high-dimensional datasets where traditional ML methods struggle. Turn promising research into models and systems that can solve difficult real-world problems. About You You’ve done exceptional AI research at a frontier AI lab, leading research initiatives and helping set technical direction. You have deep expertise in modern AI architectures, model training and machine learning. You have a strong research track record, including relevant publications. You have strong mathematical and statistical foundations and know how to tackle difficult problems with limited, complex data. You’re a hands-on technical leader who can guide other researchers while developing, testing and implementing your own ideas. Nice to Have Experience with frontier tabular ML methods. Experience applying ML to financial markets or complex, high-dimensional datasets. Location Hybrid, 3 days per week on-site at our office in Menlo Park, CA, London, or Zurich. Relocation allowance available. Compensation Competitive cash compensation commensurate with experience, plus equity and carry (share of fund profits). Benefits We offer excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage, alongside a strong benefits package that includes catered lunches, commuter benefits, and more. For U.S. candidates, current legal authorization to work in the US required; continuing work visa sponsorship available for full-time employees. Working at Poesis As an early team member, you’ll help shape not just the product, but how the company operates. Your decisions will have lasting impact across the business. You’ll build from first principles, with no legacy systems, or entrenched processes slowing you down. Our team is made up of people from elite companies and universities who are low ego, collaborative, and excited to build together. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

improvement.</li> <li>Set shared technical standards and architectural direction across teams, working with engineering and data science leaders to translate them into production systems.</li> allowance</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working
