Voor onze volop in beweging zijnde HR administratie/HR-support team zoeken we een ervaren HR-professional die goed thuis is in HR operatie en graag meedenkt over uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen. Met een proactieve blik kijk je verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk en zie je kansen om processen te verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf hierin en bouw je graag mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze afdeling? Solliciteer dan snel! Wat ga je doen? Jij zorgt er samen met je hr-collega’s voor dat de basis van onze HR-administratie op orde is, maar jouw meerwaarde zit vooral in het behandelen van complexere operationele HR-vraagstukken, het ondersteunen van HR collega’s en het samen met de teamleider verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor het HR-team en een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor NLR medewerkers en HR-adviseurs. Als senior HR medewerker heb je een veelzijdige rol waarin HR-administratie, dienstverlening, inhoudelijke expertise en procesverbetering samenkomen. Jouw HR collega’s houden zich bezig met de dagelijkse HR-processen, waarbij jij je richt op vooral vraagstukken die meer ervaring, inzicht en zelfstandigheid vragen. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's, denk je mee over een slimme verdeling van het werk en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening. Jouw werkzaamheden in het kort: Vraagbaak voor het HR-team : je behandelt tweedelijns HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR processen, detachering, inleen en deelt je kennis en ondersteunt collega’s. Samenwerken met de teamleider HR : je werkt aan HR-projecten, verbetert processen en bewaakt de voortgang, met name bij piekmomenten. Ondersteunen van de HR Adviseurs en managers : je helpt bij operationele HR-vraagstukken en zorgt voor een goede aansluiting tussen HR-processen en de praktijk. Zorgen voor goede HR-dienstverlening : je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de HR-administratie en hebt contact met medewerkers. Je draagt bij aan een juiste en tijdige verwerking van personeelsgegevens en ondersteunt waar nodig bij eerstelijnsvragen. Bouwen aan de HR-afdeling : je signaleert knelpunten, denkt mee over praktische/operationele verbeteringen, helpt werkprocessen te uniformeren en deelt je kennis met collega's. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken iemand die senioriteit laat zien in zowel gedrag als HR-kennis. Je hoeft niet alles te weten, maar je hebt een stevige basis, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer afstemming nodig is. First time right is het devies, kwalitatieve en zorgvuldige HR administratie en dienstverlening vinden wij belangrijk. Verder breng je mee: Afgeronde opleiding in HRM of een vergelijkbare richting met minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring binnen HR, bij voorkeur in een brede HR-administratieve functie en kennis van AFAS. Je hebt gedegen kennis van HR administratie en support en ervaring met het zelfstandig behandelen van HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden en personeelsregelingen. Je bent communicatief sterk, toegankelijk en klantgericht. Je maakt gemakkelijk contact met medewerkers en collega’s op verschillende niveaus. Je werkt graag samen, durft je eigen perspectief in te brengen en staat open voor feedback en andere inzichten. Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor details en houdt overzicht en helpt collega’s om werkzaamheden goed en tijdig af te ronden. Je bent gewend en krijgt er energie van om in een snel groeiende en veranderende organisatie te werken. Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op C1 niveau. Wat bieden wij jou? Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightechomgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé. Verder bieden we je onder andere: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4400,- en € 5000 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) , afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring; 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek); 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer. Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden; De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving Je wordt onderdeel van een breed HR-team met verschillende expertises, van HR-advies en beleid tot recruitment en Learning & Development. We sparren graag met elkaar, houden elkaar scherp en inspireren elkaar om verder te komen. Er is volop ruimte voor jouw ideeën, kennis en initiatief, met oog voor elkaar en het gezamenlijke resultaat. Samen werken we aan HR-dienstverlening die aansluit bij de behoeften van de organisatie en bijdraagt aan onze strategische ambities. Onze HR-afdeling is volop in ontwikkeling en werkt aan verdere professionalisering en verbetering van processen en samenwerking. Dat biedt kansen, maar vraagt ook iets van jou. Je komt terecht in een HR-afdeling waar we volop werken aan het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening. We brengen meer structuur aan, maken onze processen eenvoudiger en werken steeds nauwer samen. Dat betekent dat niet alles al vastligt en dat er ruimte is om mee te denken en dingen slimmer te organiseren. Je standplaats is Amsterdam of Marknesse , maar je bent ook regelmatig op onze andere locatie voor overleg en samenwerking met collega’s. Wat betekent werken bij NLR? Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving. Wil jij meer weten? Mail dan met Christel Bouwers (Recruiter) via Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag  hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons  YouTube kanaal . Solliciteren? Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.   Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD. Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Our tools transform data into actionable insights that help decision-makers in healthcare navigate the sensitive balancing act of affordability, accessibility and quality of care. Trust and privacy are fundamental to our work, ensuring reliable and secure data for confident healthcare decisions. As Marketing Communication Intern, you will join LOGEX’s International Marketing team during an exciting scale-up phase. We are here to communicate our expertise in a proactive way to our European audiences and we need your enthusiasm and creativity to contribute to this goal. Your impact and responsibilities Content Creation & Copywriting: Support the development of blogs, website content, newsletters and social media posts. You will work alongside experienced marketing and communications professionals who will help define the brief, provide guidance during content creation and review all deliverables before publication. This is an ideal opportunity to develop professional writing and communication skills in a supportive environment. Visual Content Development: Create and adapt visuals for social posts, presentations and marketing materials. While major designs are reviewed by senior colleagues, you have a good eye for layout, branding and visual communication. Project Management: With your structured approach to tasks, you help keep content projects moving forward with punctuality and precision. Analytics & Reporting: Use your analytical skills to monitor and report on the performance of social media, website and email campaigns. Collaboration: Work closely with colleagues across Marketing, Sales and local market teams to support a wide range of communication initiatives. Your team Join a diverse team of field marketers, digital marketers and communication professionals, located in the Netherlands and Germany. Your profile Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Communication, Marketing or a related field. A natural curiosity and are eager to learn. Strong writing skills and an interest in content creation and social media. Have an eye for design. Have good communication and interpersonal skills and you enjoy collaborating with others. Have a hands-on mentality and a proactive, solution-oriented approach. Are fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch, German or other languages is a plus. Are available for a minimum of 5 consecutive months. Why LOGEX? We offer an internship allowance of €500 per month . An excellent compensation package (salary, holiday allowance, NS Business Card, phone and internet allowance) 25 vacation days (based on full-time employment) to recharge, with the option to purchase additional days An informal working environment with motivated colleagues The possibility to work in a hybrid setup A laptop and everything you need to set up a comfortable and ergonomic home office Personal and professional development opportunities through our LOGEX Academy Access to our mental health partner, OpenUp Regular after-work drinks and many more social events Contact us! As we strive to create a workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, regardless of their race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic, we encourage everyone to apply. title: Product Designer
description: Software is not just vital but a strategic cornerstone of our operations. We’re looking for a Product Designer to set the cross-application UX direction for our commercial software - from pharma cold-chain visibility that helps temperature-sensitive medicines move safely around the world, to ULD tracking for airlines. You’ll define a consistent, high-quality experience across our modules and applications and support our specialised designers in bringing that experience to life, while remaining hands-on in discovery, from the first user conversation through to the final UX. 📍 Location: We are open to candidates based anywhere within the UK, Spain, and the Netherlands, with remote working available within these countries . Hybrid option available in the Netherlands. Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions. Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide. Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains. Why SkyCell? 🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare. 🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation. 🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way. 💡 Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell. 🏆 Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being. What You'll Do: A dedicated framework team owns our Design System and Design Guidelines, while embedded designers craft the screens and flows within each product module. Your role is to set the overall direction for the experience they design towards — including experience principles, end-to-end journeys and measurable outcomes that help multiple modules feel like one product. You will: Lead discovery end-to-end, including user research and interviews, journey mapping, jobs-to-be-done, pain points and opportunities, and translate research into a shared foundation for UX and product decisions Create wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes hands-on using Figma and/or code to explore and test concepts during discovery, and run evaluative tests with users and engineers Define the cross-application UX vision, design principles and success metrics together with Product and Marketing Support and align our specialised designers - framework and embedded - around a consistent experience across modules and applications Communicate UX principles and investment priorities to senior leadership, demonstrating the value and potential impact of UX-related roadmap items Maintain the UX roadmap and prioritise pattern and design investments with the framework team Produce high-level experience flows and service blueprints that connect journeys across applications and domains Review Design System and module deliverables for alignment with experience strategy and brand Support embedded designers from discovery through to delivery by co-framing problems, reviewing flows against the cross-application blueprint and ensuring continuity across user journeys Set KPIs and use analytics, user research, A/B tests and competitive analysis to inform and refine design decisions Promote a UX culture centred on user needs, inclusive design and accessibility standards such as WCAG across the organisation Collaborate with Marketing on tone, terminology and brand consistency across products What You'll Bring: Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Experience as a senior or lead product designer working on complex B2B software, ideally within supply chain, logistics, aviation/air cargo or pharma Strong experience leading discovery, from understanding user needs through research and prototyping to defining and refining UX solutions Advanced proficiency in Figma, with experience creating and iterating wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes Experience bringing together multiple designers, including without formal reporting lines, to create a consistent experience across products or modules Ability to communicate UX strategy, priorities and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders Working knowledge of design systems and accessibility standards such as WCAG; experience partnering with design system teams is an advantage Experience designing for multiple user groups, such as pharma quality/logistics teams and airline cargo operations, is beneficial If you don’t meet every requirement but bring relevant experience and skills, we’d still like to hear from you. What's In It For You? ⚡ Flexibility & Balance: Flexible working hours and work-life balance allow you to tailor work to fit your life. 🌟 Recognition & Growth: Opportunities for career advancement in a company that values your contributions. 🌍 Flexible ways of working: Our global teams work across our offices in Zurich, Zug, Hyderabad and Basel, with a mix of on-site, hybrid and remote working. Role-specific locations and working arrangements are detailed above. 🎉 Company-wide Events: Join us for company events to celebrate successes, build teams, and share our vision. Plus, new joiners experience SkyWeek, our immersive onboarding program. 👶 Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave: Support for new parents with competitive maternity and paternity leave. 🏖️ Annual Leave & Bank Holidays: Enjoy a generous annual leave package, plus local bank holidays to recharge and unwind. Ready to Make an Impact? We’re not just offering a job; we’re offering a chance to be part of something bigger. At SkyCell, you’ll help build a future where pharmaceutical delivery is efficient, sustainable, and transformative. Stay Connected with SkyCell Visit http://www.skycell.ch and explore #WeAreSkyCell on LinkedIn How to Apply Simply click ‘apply for this job’ below! We can’t wait to meet you and discuss how you can contribute to our mission! Please note, we are unable to consider applications sent to us via email. If you have any questions, you can contact our Talent Team ( For this position, if you are not located in, or able to relocate (without sponsorship) to one of the advertised locations, your application cannot be considered. Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Why SkyCell?

🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.

🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.

🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.

  • Support and align our specialised designers - framework and embedded - around a consistent experience across modules and applications

  • Communicate UX principles and investment priorities to senior leadership, demonstrating the value and potential impact of UX-related roadmap items

  • Produce high-level experience flows and service blueprints that connect journeys across applications and domains

  • Support embedded designers from discovery through to delivery by co-framing problems, reviewing flows against the cross-application blueprint and ensuring continuity across user journeys

Power our growing crew from day one. Keep our people operations running sharp – so every colleague feels supported, valued, and ready to aim high.

As our HR Operations Specialist, you keep the operational heartbeat of Robin Radar steady and reliable. You guide colleagues and managers through everyday questions while managing key processes from onboarding to payroll and pensions. Working alongside the Head of HR, you turn complex regulations into clear, smooth procedures that support our international team. You play a vital part in making our workplace an environment where bright minds thrive[cite: 1, 3].

What you'll do

  • People operations and lifecycle management: Oversee essential lifecycle processes including contract management, visa and 30% ruling applications, leaves, and absenteeism. Ensure policies are followed while advising on necessary updates.

  • HR systems and digital tools: Maintain and control our core systems, including HiBob, Odoo, and Officevibe. Act as the primary go-to specialist for system knowledge and drive continuous platform improvements.

  • Onboarding and colleague support: Organise and host our monthly onboarding days to welcome new joiners. Deliver clear guidance to colleagues and managers on day-to-day queries with a customer-focused approach.

  • External partnerships and compliance: Act as the direct point of contact for external payroll, pension, occupational health, and legal partners. Track changes in labour law to keep our personnel policies and handbook up to date.

  • HR analytics and projects: Develop meaningful HR reports and analytics to inform people decisions. Lead and support projects, from implementing new systems to rolling out fresh policies.

What you bring

  • BA/MSc or HBO in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field

  • Over 5 years of experience, ideally in international/multicultural settings

  • Knowledge of Dutch employment law with a focus on migrant employment requirements

  • Familiarity with HR systems like HiBob is a plus

  • Fluent in both English and Dutch

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

  • Team player with the ability to work independently

  • Assertive and hands-on approach

  • Proactive mindset with a focus on driving improvements

  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate across diverse cultures and backgrounds

What we offer

  • Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

  • Comprehensive pension plan;

  • Commuting allowance;

  • 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

  • Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

  • High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role

  • An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

title: Staff Backend Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE 🌍 Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does. Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work. We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟 Your decisions here won't get lost in a big system. They'll define it. As Staff Backend Engineer for Manychat for Brands, you’ll own the technical side of a new product. You’ll set the architecture and technical priorities with the team, and decide what lives in our Python services and what stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. It’s an individual contributor role with a lot of room to make an impact. The product fills a real gap. Brands pay influencers to post but then can’t see what happens next. We’re building the first view that shows it: who asked for the link, who opened the DM, who clicked, for every campaign, creator and post. You’ll work with Product as a partner and stay close to brands and creators, so feedback reaches you fast and helps you shape Manychat for Brands. Sound like you? Let’s talk! YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋 Meet the Engineering team: We keep Manychat running smoothly under high load every single day and make sure it's ready to scale even further. We do it by combining strong engineering foundations with AI tools that let us move faster without cutting corners. And we're the ones who shape and own what gets built. AI accelerates. Humans own the thinking. WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀 Set the architecture and technical priorities for Brands together with the Engineering Manager and the team: service boundaries, data models, authentication, access control, and integration with the core Manychat platform. Decide which logic belongs in the Python-based Brands services and which stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. Think about data ownership, reliability, and long-term maintenance. Lead big system-level changes when the path isn't clear yet. Explore options, split the work into measurable milestones, and plan data migrations, gradual rollouts, and rollbacks. Define reliability and performance requirements for key Brands workflows. Set metrics and observability, and check the impact of your changes on production data. Find the root causes of slowdowns and repeated incidents across service boundaries, using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing. Work with Security, Infrastructure, and Platform teams on solutions. Decide what to fix in the application and what needs other teams, and explain the trade-offs clearly. Work with Product on the approach and scope of solutions, and suggest simpler options when you see them. Make technical decisions easy to follow: document key choices and the reasons behind them, do thorough design and code reviews, and share your knowledge in complex areas. TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥 You'll need: Deep expertise in Python backend development and a broad view of backend architecture beyond one language. You can understand existing systems, even when the technology is new to you. A strong product mindset. You work closely with Product Managers, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade-offs in terms of user experience, timelines, and product capabilities. Experience owning the architecture and production operations of a product or a large technical area, not only delivering separate features. title: AI Builder
description: The short version Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in. As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching. We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building. What Contentoo does Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap. None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster. There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. The difference is that we get those foundations right first and then actually do the work. We've been doing that for ten years: 300+ brands, 300,000+ completed projects and 49 languages. What you'll do A suite of Workflows already runs in production, from localisation and creation to brand checks and content refresh. Each one combines AI agents with human experts and works from the client's brand context. In practice, your week splits two ways. Half of it is implementation: getting new clients live, finding out where their situation is different from the last client's, and building the fix quickly, whether that's a new skill for their agent, a connection to their CMS, or a check only their market needs. Then you make that whole process faster and more automated on our side, so the next client goes live with less hand work. The other half is the layer on top, which we're building right now: brand intelligence. Today most marketing teams guess what to write next. We want every client to know. Their own search data shows which pages are slipping, and a page that slips already gets a one-click refresh. Competitor rankings show where others win the topics the client should own. Strategy gets drafted from search data in each market and confirmed by the client, so every piece has a reason to exist. And every week we ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI to answer the questions their buyers ask, to see whether the client is named or a competitor is. Every expert fix and every client comment flows back into the brand context, so the platform gets better with each piece. What works for one client becomes a feature for all of them. And our own teams are clients too. Sales asks the CRM and the agents for a prospect's history before a call. Anyone in the company can ask Conny, our assistant on top of KIWI, our company knowledge base, how billing works or what a package includes. Product feedback from clients gets sorted and routed to the right owner by an agent. When one of those tools needs to get better, you build that too, with Claude Code, the Claude and GPT APIs, MCP servers and agent skills: whatever does the job. The team You join the Product team under Olivier (CPO) and report to Joost (AI Lead), in our growing AI team. You'll work closely with Jorge (Product Lead), Cesar (Tech Lead) and our development hub in Valencia. Around you are the Connies: our people in Amsterdam and in our growing Valencia office. Once a month we stop for Success & Drinks, a company update with no slides and lots of energy, where anyone can take the floor to show what they've built. Wins get celebrated in #shoutout, from a sales call that nailed it to the talent team finding the right experts for a client's healthcare content. We play a padel tournament every year, run the city business run together (the ones who don't run come for the drinks afterwards), and take honest feedback seriously enough to train for it. Who you are You're a builder who gets energy from seeing a client actually use what you made. Three things come together in you: Judgement. You quickly see what's really going on with a client, and you're as credible talking ROI with a CFO as architecture with an engineer. You build. You prototype fast and ship, and you're at home with LLM APIs, agents, MCP, skills, and tools like Claude Code. You've built AI tools that real people use, and you can tell us what happened after launch. Hands in the mud. You love being close to clients: fixing what gets in their way, building what solves their next problem, and owning what you ship. Under the hood, it has to work, stay up, and be safe. Your best hours go to the client. You might come from strategy, product, solutions engineering, or technical implementation. Or you became the AI person at your last company and want a lot more of it. Fluent English is a must; Dutch is a plus. We are looking for someone available 32-40h per week. If seeing a client use something you built last week excites you more than perfecting the architecture behind it, you'll love it here. You'd be building on a business that's doing very well, with a large network of expert freelancers behind it: clients, data, and experts from day one, and an operation that keeps running while we scale. If you'd rather start from a blank page, a startup will suit you better. But if you want to make AI fly at scale, this is the place. What you’ll get A competitive salary based on experience 25 vacation days per year Pension contribution Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens, 2-3 days in office, plus remote flexibility) A small AI team with a mandate to grow: real leadership opportunities, an L&D budget and direct exposure to the MT and founders Laptop of choice (Mac or HP) A monthly Alleo budget A learning budget Lunch and a bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?! A fun, inclusive team, regular company events, boat days, and more Why Contentoo, why now You'll build things people keep using. In client conversations, in the code and in the product, every week. The foundations are already there. 300+ clients, real integrations, structured brand context, Workflows in production, and real budget committed to AI. You build on top, not from zero. The market is wide open. Most enterprises are stuck somewhere between "we bought ChatGPT licences" and "our content still isn't better". We're building the bridge, and there's no playbook for it yet. What you build compounds. A win for one client becomes a feature for all of them. Sounds interesting? raw.title: Senior Product Engineer - Booking Management
raw.description:
Hi! 👋 I'm Sam, Engineering Manager for Team Booking Management at WeTravel.

I joined WeTravel to help simplify how group travel businesses handle payments and bookings. Our Booking Management team owns the journey from the moment a traveler decides to book: checkout flows, order management, tax management, and everything that enables travelers to easily make a reservation and manage it afterwards. Last year alone, over a million travelers booked adventures through our platform! As we streamline and localize our booking experience, I'm looking for engineers who are excited about making complex booking and commerce flows feel simple for our global users.

About WeTravel:

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform makes it simple for organizers to create beautiful trip proposals, securely process payments, and manage their customers, so they can focus on what they do best: creating amazing experiences.

This is one of the last great frontiers of travel to come online, and as the category leader, we are at the forefront of this change. Last year alone, our platform was trusted by 8,000 organizers to lead over a million travelers on adventures in 150+ countries. Now, we're on an exciting journey to grow from powering $1B to $10B in travel experiences per year.

We believe that every trip, when done right, can be a force for good - and we're building the engine to make more of that possible.

What's the role:

You will join the Booking Management team to lead critical projects across checkout, order management, tax management, and traveler self-service. Upcoming work includes:

  • Checkout experience: streamlining and localizing our checkout flows so travelers in every market can complete a reservation in just a few clicks.

  • Order management: building the foundational systems for organizers and travelers to view, modify, and manage reservations end-to-end - changes, transfers, cancellations, and everything in between.

  • Tax management: expanding our tax capabilities across jurisdictions so organizers can sell compliantly wherever their travelers are.

  • Reliability and structural improvements: scaling our booking flows to support 10x growth.

What you'll do day-to-day:

  • Lead booking projects end-to-end: discovery with Product and Customer teams, solution design, build, rollout, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Partner with the Product team to gain insight into organizer and traveler challenges, building booking experiences that convert and delight.

  • Own the reliability of our booking and order management systems

  • Contribute to WeTravel's engineering practices and excellence.

How we work:

  • We're focused on the impact. We don't subscribe to any one framework or execution ideology, and we adapt based on what's impactful.

  • We're using the latest hardware and constantly on the look out for better tools & ways to work.

  • We have AI-first development experience and work with the latest models and agentic dev tools.

  • Stack: We're developing React/TypeScript, Ruby on Rails and Kotlin Microservices. Our services run on Kubernetes. We also use and love MongoDB, MySQL, Postgres, Snowflake and we're working with the major LLM providers.

You should apply if you have:

Basic qualifications:

  • 7+ years of product engineering expertise, with 4+ years dedicated to architecting complex e-commerce, booking, or order management systems.

  • Proven track record within a high-scale consumer checkout, marketplace, travel, or e-commerce platform team.

  • Broad practical expertise in building and troubleshooting production-level checkout and order flows: conversion-critical funnels, pricing and tax calculation, availability and inventory, cancellations, modifications, and refund flows. You possess deeply ingrained expertise in order state machines, multi-step form UX, and the operational tooling that keeps commerce systems running.

  • Strong backend mastery in Ruby on Rails, Kotlin, Python, Go, Java, or Node.js with the agility to ramp up on Ruby quickly.

  • Full-stack comfort: you can build the React interface for the booking flows you architect.

  • Deep expertise in architecting robust, resilient distributed systems, including order and reservation state machines, idempotency, exactly-once semantics, event-driven architectures, webhooks, and reliable consumer patterns.

  • Direct production on-call experience, including authoring post-mortems and leading incident response.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including cross-functional collaboration experience, and the ability to thrive in a distributed, multicultural environment.

  • Pragmatic adoption of AI tools to optimize your engineering workflow, including the ability to mentor and train others on AI concepts.

Technical Skills

  • Strong background in cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), containerization, and modern CI/CD practices.

  • Experience in handling critical systems with precision: you will handle pricing and tax logic directly within the application layer.

  • Bonus: Direct experience with tax engines or multi-jurisdiction tax compliance (VAT, GST, sales tax), or with travel-industry reservation systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience launching or significantly redesigning a checkout or booking flow end-to-end.

  • Experience building tax calculation or compliance capabilities across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Experience in marketplace or two-sided platform commerce (orders spanning buyers, sellers, and modifications over time).

You might not be the right fit if you:

  • Your commerce expertise is limited to plugging in off-the-shelf checkout or cart solutions. We need someone who operates deeply beneath that abstraction layer.

  • You are hesitant to take full ownership of mission-critical booking flows or participate in the on-call rotation when systems fail.

Why join us?

  • Solve real commerce problems at real volume: over a million travelers booking adventures in 150+ countries, and growing.

  • Make a real impact: you'll help build the operating system for the multi-day group travel industry, empowering thousands of organizers and millions of travelers worldwide.

  • Solve meaningful technical challenges at scale, from designing robust systems to improving real-time user experiences in a complex domain.

title: Manager Service Operations & AI
description: Ben jij een ervaren IT Operations Manager die niet alleen een supportorganisatie kan aansturen, maar ook kansen ziet om dienstverlening slimmer en efficiënter te maken met AI? Dan hebben wij een interessante uitdaging voor je. Voor Fivespark, een ambitieuze Managed Service Provider in Amstelveen, zoeken wij een Manager Service Operations & AI. In deze veelzijdige functie combineer je operationeel leiderschap met procesverbetering, automatisering en de verdere ontwikkeling van een eigen AI-agent. Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid over een team van 12 supportprofessionals én speelt een belangrijke rol in de transformatie naar een steeds verder geautomatiseerde IT-dienstverlening. Over Fivespark Fivespark is een innovatieve Managed Service Provider die bedrijven en overheden ondersteunt met moderne IT-oplossingen. De organisatie werkt aan de Managed Service Provider van de toekomst, waarin automatisering, kunstmatige intelligentie en datagedreven processen een steeds grotere rol spelen. Een belangrijk onderdeel hiervan is Sparkle, een intern ontwikkelde AI-agent die nu al ondersteunt bij ticketregistratie, triage, klantvragen en routering. De ambitie is om Sparkle verder te ontwikkelen tot een volwaardige digitale collega die steeds meer operationele processen zelfstandig en betrouwbaar kan uitvoeren. De organisatie kenmerkt zich door korte lijnen, een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid. Wat ga je doen? Als Manager Service Operations & AI ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en verdere professionalisering van de tweedelijns supportorganisatie. Tegelijkertijd speel je een centrale rol in het ontwikkelen en implementeren van AI en automatisering. Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit vier belangrijke onderdelen. Leidinggeven aan de supportorganisatie Je geeft leiding aan een team van 12 tweedelijns supportmedewerkers. Je coacht en ontwikkelt medewerkers en zorgt voor duidelijke prioriteiten, structuur en samenwerking. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, capaciteit, continuïteit en prestaties van de dienstverlening. Je signaleert knelpunten en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteracties. Doorontwikkelen van AI-agent Sparkle Je bent functioneel eigenaar van Sparkle en bepaalt mede de visie, roadmap en prioriteiten. Je vertaalt operationele uitdagingen naar praktische AI-toepassingen. Je zorgt ervoor dat Sparkle veilig, betrouwbaar en gebruiksvriendelijk functioneert. Je werkt samen met technische specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van deze digitale collega. Processen verbeteren en automatiseren Je analyseert bestaande operationele processen en identificeert mogelijkheden voor automatisering. Je optimaliseert workflows, kennisbanken en werkinstructies. Je zorgt voor een goede samenwerking tussen medewerkers en AI. Je draagt bij aan de ambitie om minimaal 75% van de standaard operationele processen met AI te ondersteunen of volledig te automatiseren. Verandering begeleiden Je werkt samen met Operations, Software Development, Business Consultancy en externe partners. Je begeleidt medewerkers in de overgang naar een meer AI-gedreven manier van werken. Je creëert draagvlak, communiceert helder en zorgt ervoor dat veranderingen daadwerkelijk worden doorgevoerd. Wie zoeken wij? Wij zoeken een operationeel sterke manager die structuur weet aan te brengen, medewerkers kan motiveren en tegelijkertijd vooruitkijkt naar de mogelijkheden van nieuwe technologie. Je begrijpt hoe een IT-supportorganisatie werkt, weet hoe je processen beheersbaar en voorspelbaar maakt en krijgt energie van het continu verbeteren van de dienstverlening. Daarnaast beschik je over: Hbo- of wo-werk- en -denkniveau. Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen Managed Services, ICT Operations of IT Service Management. title: Senior China Research Analyst
description: Datenna is a fast-growing tech scale-up combining cutting-edge OSINT and AI technologies to provide governments with critical insights into China's techno-economic landscape. Our platform transforms open-source intelligence into actionable insights through advanced data processing and analysis. The Role: Do you enjoy turning complex data into strategic insights that drive critical decisions? As a Senior China Research Analyst, you will lead analytical research projects for our government clients. You'll turn their most pressing questions about China's technology, industrial, and defence-industrial landscape into data-driven reports and the datasets behind them. You'll work with Datenna's data on patents, procurement, research funding, and companies, and go beyond it when a question demands, to find the patterns and connections that inform high-stakes policy and security decisions.   You'll independently manage several client research projects at a time, from scoping through final delivery, using both qualitative and quantitative analysis across China's corporate, academic, defence, and technology sectors. Client questions often start ambiguous and open-ended, and topics range widely, from advanced materials to semiconductors and aerospace. You'll work through uncertainty, get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar technologies, design creative analytical approaches when the path isn't obvious, and refine your research direction as new information emerges. The role needs strong China expertise, Chinese-language research skills, the ability to work autonomously, and clear communication with senior government stakeholders.     Your mission at Datenna: Lead end-to-end research delivery: Take full ownership of research projects, from initial scoping and analysis through to final deliverables.   Design the research: Turn open-ended client questions into sound research design, and build new analytical frameworks when standard methods don't fit.   Build and analyse the evidence base: Work directly with Chinese-language sources and Datenna's data on entities, patents, procurement, and research funding to map the actors, links, and trends that answer the client's question.   Set the quality bar: Review colleagues' deliverables independently, verify findings against the underlying data, and guide Analysts on their research approach.   Work with AI, with judgement: Use AI-assisted research tools to work faster and at greater scale. raw.title: Senior China Research Analyst
raw.description:
Datenna is a fast-growing tech scale-up combining cutting-edge OSINT and AI technologies to provide governments with critical insights into China's techno-economic landscape. Our platform transforms open-source intelligence into actionable insights through advanced data processing and analysis.


The Role:
Do you enjoy turning complex data into strategic insights that drive critical decisions? As a Senior China Research Analyst, you will lead analytical research projects for our government clients. You'll turn their most pressing questions about China's technology, industrial, and defence-industrial landscape into data-driven reports and the datasets behind them. You'll work with Datenna's data on patents, procurement, research funding, and companies, and go beyond it when a question demands, to find the patterns and connections that inform high-stakes policy and security decisions. 


You'll independently manage several client research projects at a time, from scoping through final delivery, using both qualitative and quantitative analysis across China's corporate, academic, defence, and technology sectors. Client questions often start ambiguous and open-ended, and topics range widely, from advanced materials to semiconductors and aerospace. You'll work through uncertainty, get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar technologies, design creative analytical approaches when the path isn't obvious, and refine your research direction as new information emerges. The role needs strong China expertise, Chinese-language research skills, the ability to work autonomously, and clear communication with senior government stakeholders. 

 

Your mission at Datenna:

  • Lead end-to-end research delivery: Take full ownership of research projects, from initial scoping and analysis through to final deliverables. 

  • Design the research: Turn open-ended client questions into sound research design, and build new analytical frameworks when standard methods don't fit. 

  • Build and analyse the evidence base: Work directly with Chinese-language sources and Datenna's data on entities, patents, procurement, and research funding to map the actors, links, and trends that answer the client's question. 

  • Set the quality bar: Review colleagues' deliverables independently, verify findings against the underlying data, and guide Analysts on their research approach. 

  • Work with AI, with judgement: Use AI-assisted research tools to work faster and at greater scale. You own the interpretation and verify every output. 

  • Contribute to the China Research Lab: The Lab is our exploratory research track. It develops the methods, tools, and data sources that shape where China research at Datenna is heading, and tests them through internal R&D. You will dedicate part of your time to Lab initiatives, such as prototyping a new analytical approach, scouting and testing new sources, or contributing to webinars and publications. 

  • Strengthen the data and product: Turn what you learn on client projects into data and product improvements, working with the Product and Data teams. 


What makes you a great candidate:
Core requirements 

  • Experience: 5–8 years of professional experience in China-focused research, analysis, or related fields. 

  • Deep China expertise: Strong knowledge of Chinese industry, economy, policy, the defence-industrial base, and the technology and research landscape. 

  • Analytical excellence: Exceptional pattern recognition and analytical skills to connect the dots between corporate, state, and military actors in China's techno-economic landscape. 

  • Comfort with ambiguity: Proven ability to tackle research questions where the analytical path isn't predetermined, designing creative approaches and adapting as you learn. 

  • Chinese language proficiency: Professional reading proficiency in Chinese (minimum HSK5, HSK6 preferred) to work directly with Chinese-language sources such as technical literature, patents, procurement notices, and policy documents, and to build and verify Chinese technical terminology for data retrieval. 

  • Self-directed project management: Proven ability to independently break down complex research questions, run several multi-week projects in parallel against fixed client deadlines, and deliver high-quality output with minimal oversight. 

  • Quality ownership: An evidence-first approach. You trace every claim back to its source records, catch inconsistencies in data and drafts, and review others' work independently and constructively. 

  • Communication skills: Strong written and verbal communication, including precise, concise English writing for an international readership. You are comfortable presenting complex analysis to senior government stakeholders and refining requirements through client dialogue. 

  • Methodological versatility: Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative research methods. 


Technical skills 

  • Working proficiency in SQL and/or Python to query, clean, and structure large datasets, plus advanced Excel. 

  • Hands-on experience using LLM-based tools in research, with a clear sense of where their output needs human verification. 

  • Familiarity with data-quality work such as deduplication and entity resolution. 


Nice to have 

  • Experience in the technology, science, and research sector within governmental organisations, think tanks, or international corporate settings. 

  • Background conducting research for external clients or stakeholders. 

  • Experience analysing patents, public procurement, research funding, or corporate registry data. 

  • Experience collecting web data from Chinese-language sources, or with BI tools such as Metabase. 

  • A technical or scientific background (for example materials science, engineering, or physics) relevant to dual-use technology topics. 

*Please know that applicants may be subject to a screening process.*


  • Work on globally impactful projects in geopolitical intelligence

  • Lead innovation in OSINT and AI technologies

  • Competitive compensation and benefits

  • Dynamic, international team environment

  • Significant growth opportunities in a scale-up

When you apply to this position, we will process your personal data according to our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

title: Business Analyst - Enterprise & AI Solutions
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><h3>Working in technology &amp; innovation with WPP Enterprise Solutions</h3> <p>At WPP Enterprise Solutions Netherlands, we create connected brands to drive growth. Our expertise spans the full customer journey, with deep capabilities in commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, technology, content, media and more. We deliver end-to-end solutions for ambitious B2B and B2C brands, supported by the wider WPP network.</p> <p>Our work combines strategy, product thinking, experience design, data, engineering and AI to solve real business problems, from enterprise commerce modernisation and digital shelf excellence to AI-enabled content operations, marketing automation, GEO, workflow orchestration and custom AI agents.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>You’ll join the Product Management &amp; AI Solutions team: the group that bridges business strategy, customer experience and technology to deliver scalable commerce and enterprise solutions. We work closely with UX/CX, Data &amp; AI, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Paid and Retail Media, Engineering and Delivery teams.</p> <p>Our ambition is to move beyond isolated skills and build repeatable, outcome-led propositions around commerce growth topics such as Search &amp; Discovery, Personalisation, CRO &amp; Experience Optimisation, Product Data/PIM &amp; Digital Shelf, Content Supply Chain &amp; AI Content Operations, CRM &amp; Lifecycle Growth, Performance &amp; Retail Media, SEO/GEO and Composable Commerce Modernisation. Alongside this, we are growing our applied AI work: shaping and delivering custom AI agents and AI-enabled workflows for clients, from discovery and pilot through to production and continuous improvement.</p> <h3>Why this role exists</h3> <p>Clients are increasingly asking for integrated solutions rather than isolated delivery capacity. They need people who can understand the business problem, shape the product direction, define the right solution, translate it into clear specifications and guide teams through delivery. At the same time, AI is changing how commerce, content, marketing and operations work, creating a need for analysts who can combine structured requirements thinking with product ownership, enterprise technology understanding and the design of AI-enabled workflows and agents.</p> <p>This role is designed for someone who can operate as a strong Business Analyst, step into Product Owner responsibilities when needed, advocate for product thinking inside the organisation and help turn our AI and commerce capabilities into scalable client value. You will work across both our commerce and enterprise product work and our applied AI work. The mix depends on client demand, and we expect the AI share to grow over time.</p> <h3>The role</h3> <p>As Business Analyst, Enterprise &amp; AI Solutions, you bridge business needs, product direction and technical delivery across enterprise digital commerce and martech ecosystems. You analyse business processes, clarify user and stakeholder needs, define requirements and support solutioning across the commerce stack: CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation, paid/media platforms and integration layers.</p> <p>You will also work on AI initiatives such as custom AI agents (for example for pricing, search or customer service), content and marketing automation, product/content enrichment, GEO and organic discoverability, AI orchestration and workflow automation. You do not need to be a machine learning engineer or a domain expert, but you must be technically curious and comfortable working with APIs, data flows, automation tools, LLM-based workflows, AI quality evaluation, governance requirements and human-in-the-loop processes.</p> <p>Depending on your experience and the project context, you may act as a hands-on BA, a product-minded discovery partner, a proxy Product Owner or a work stream lead. In all cases, your job is to make ambiguity manageable, decisions explicit and delivery focused on measurable value.</p> <h3>What you will do</h3> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Solution Architects and Product Owners and translate business goals into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, tech architecture, data flows and integration specifications that delivery teams can act on.</li> <li>Work across commerce, martech and enterprise ecosystems, including CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and media platforms.</li> <li>Identify, shape and specify practical AI, automation and workflow orchestration opportunities across content, marketing, commerce and operational processes, from process mapping and readiness checks to a scoped pilot with a clear business case.</li> <li>Specify AI agents and LLM-based workflows: define the task, data sources, tools and integrations, guardrails, human-in-the-loop steps and escalation paths, plus the evaluation criteria that decide when a solution is ready to go live. After launch, help measure quality, adoption and business impact.</li> <li>Act as a Business Analyst or proxy Product Owner when needed by supporting prioritisation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, UAT, release preparation and stakeholder alignment.</li> <li>Connect business, UX, data, SEO/GEO, content, engineering, legal and delivery teams to make sure solutions are valuable, feasible, scalable and well governed.</li> <li>Help make our AI work repeatable and sellable: contribute to proposals, scoping and estimates, and build reusable assets such as discovery templates, requirement patterns, evaluation sets and playbooks.</li> <li>At the senior end of the role, independently lead workstreams, own parts of the client relationship and coach junior analysts or product team members.</li> </ul> <h3>Who you are</h3> <ul> <li>A structured problem-solver who starts with the business problem, not only the requested feature.</li> <li>A product-minded Business Analyst who can move between discovery, specification, prioritisation and delivery support.</li> <li>Comfortable acting as a proxy Product Owner when a project needs stronger product ownership.</li> <li>Technically fluent enough to discuss APIs, data flows, integrations, platform dependencies and implementation trade-offs with engineering teams.</li> <li>Curious and pragmatic about AI: you use AI tools in your own work and understand the opportunity, but also the need for governance, quality, reliability and human oversight.</li> <li>Comfortable with fast-moving technology: you focus on the problem and the outcome rather than a specific tool, and you pick up new platforms quickly.</li> <li>Strong in workshops, stakeholder alignment and decision-making, with the confidence to challenge constructively.</li> <li>Able to represent the Product Management &amp; AI Solutions team inside WPP and help other teams understand the value of product thinking and applied AI.</li> <li>Commercially aware: you can connect requirements and solutions to client value, efficiency, scalability, conversion, discoverability or operational impact.</li> <li>Collaborative and low-ego, with the ability to work across Commerce, UX/CX, Data, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Media, Engineering and Delivery.</li> </ul> <h3>What you’ll need</h3> <h4>The basics</h4> <ul> <li>3-5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, Solution Analyst or similar role, ideally in commerce, martech, enterprise platforms, consulting or a digital agency environment.</li> <li>Experience with digital commerce ecosystems, preferably B2B and/or B2C enterprise environments.</li> <li>Working knowledge of platforms and domains such as CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and paid/media technology.</li> <li>Strong experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, process flows and integration requirements.</li> <li>Good technical understanding of REST APIs, web platforms, data flows, system integrations and common delivery dependencies.</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with generative AI tools and a working understanding of how LLM-based solutions behave, including their limitations and how to test the quality of their output.</li> <li>Experience working in Agile delivery environments with tools such as Jira, Confluence or similar.</li> <li>Excellent communication, facilitation, documentation and stakeholder management skills.</li> <li>Fluent professional English.</li> <li>Currently residing in the Netherlands with a valid work permit.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus points</h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with automation tools such as n8n, Zapier or similar.</li> <li>Experience shaping AI, LLM, agentic or workflow orchestration use cases in a business or delivery context, ideally including at least one that went live.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI and agent platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and with concepts such as retrieval (RAG), tool use and evaluation.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI governance and regulation, such as the EU AI Act, and with responsible AI practices.</li> <li>Experience with search and personalisation platforms, composable commerce, PIM/PXM, CDP, CRM or marketing automation platforms.</li> <li>Experience with GA4, BigQuery, SQL, Python, Postman, Figma, Miro or similar tools.</li> <li>Proficiency in Dutch.</li> </ul> <h3>In return, this is what we offer</h3> <p>You’ll get access to an international network of clients, colleagues, technology partners and resources. We have a listening ear for ambitious ideas, and together we keep stretching our boundaries. We want you to follow the path you’re building, and we invest in your personal development in a dynamic, collaborative workplace.</p> <h2>Our compensation</h2> <ul> <li>A monthly salary between <strong>€4,800 and €5200</strong>&nbsp;gross, depending on your experience, seniority and fit with the role.</li> <li>A gross annual 8% holiday allowance.</li> <li>Access to our commuting package to suit your individual needs.</li> <li>Competitive pension benefits.</li> <li>A choice of a Mac or Windows laptop.</li> </ul> <h2>Our culture</h2> <ul> <li>A culture of trust, with a feel-at-home vibe and an international environment.</li> <li>Mental health support, including complimentary membership EAP counselling services.</li> <li>Wellness benefits (when available) including yoga classes, an in-house masseuse.</li> <li>The opportunity to work with a renowned international customer base of B2B and B2C brands.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>About WPP</strong></h4> <p class="p1">WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="http://wpp.com/"><span class="s1">WPP.com</span></a><span class="s2">.</span></p> <p><span class="normaltextrun"><span lang="EN-GB">WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</span></span><span class="scxw176048299"><span lang="EN-GB">&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p>When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions). Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our <a href="https://www.vml.com/recruitment-privacy-policy">Recruitment Privacy Policy</a>. California residents should read our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.vml.com/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice</a>. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
Location: Zaltbommel, Netherlands (Hybrid)

Reporting to: VP of Marketing


About Cyclomedia & The Role

Cyclomedia creates digital representations of the real world, giving professionals the visual data they need to manage assets and infrastructure. We are currently sharpening our commercial strategy. To drive this, we are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to bridge the gap between our product capabilities and the market.

In our setup, Product Management builds the solution, and Product Marketing wins the market. As part of the Marketing department, you keep our messaging strictly focused on customer value. You own the value propositions, the customer context, and the commercial message. Your output forms the foundation for all our demand generation campaigns.

The Role & Collaboration

As the owner of our value propositions, you define the go-to-market approach. You build this strategy through direct contact with customers and close alignment with sales and Product Management. Armed with this market reality, you brief our Regional Marketing Managers and Content Marketers on the target audiences, messaging, and commercial hooks required for their campaigns. You also work with our Sales Enablement team to ensure sales representatives have the materials they need to close deals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Positioning & Messaging: Translate technical product capabilities into clear positioning and go-to-market strategies that drive pipeline value and improve lead conversion rates.

  • Market Intelligence: Feed the product roadmap with market insights, buyer needs, and competitive intelligence.

  • Sales Alignment: Validate marketing materials with regional sales teams so they are fully equipped to sell the solution.

  • First 6 Months Impact: Work out the context for our top 6 value propositions and produce the foundational global marketing materials to guide upcoming demand and lead generation campaigns.

Your Profile

  • Experience: 5+ years of Product Marketing experience, or a strong commercial background deeply embedded in our core markets.

  • Domain Expertise (Preferred): A background in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or mobile mapping, or specific industry experience in utility companies, telecom network planning, public or network asset management, or engineering work planning.

  • Commercial Acumen: A proven ability to look from the outside in. You base your strategies on what the buyer needs to hear rather than what the product can do.

  • Ownership: You work independently and possess the maturity to help shape the Product Marketing function as we grow.

What We Offer

  • Room to make your mark: A challenging role in a strong, growing international company, with real freedom to shape the position.

  • A great team to join: A small, close-knit and growing marketing team, plus experienced colleagues to build on.

  • A competitive package: An attractive base salary and an 8.3% annual bonus scheme.

  • Growth: Training, online courses and (team) coaching to support your development.

  • Time off: 25 holidays, the option to buy up to 10 extra days a year, and an extra day off after Ascension Day.

  • Wellbeing: A flexible Mental Health Day each year to rest and recharge, and a sports allowance of €25 gross per month.

  • Hybrid working: 3 days in the office and 2 from home, with a home-working allowance of €2 per day.

  • The right tools: A company phone and laptop.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

Who we're looking for

We're seeking an experienced ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer to own the GPU infrastructure that powers our LLM training and serving, and to make every workload on it faster and cheaper. You'll run our H200 cluster end to end, deploy models to production, and profile and optimize our training and inference pipelines down to the kernel level when it matters. You understand GPUs from the cluster scheduler to the memory hierarchy, you measure before you optimize, and you're motivated by turning raw compute into faster iteration for our ML team. You thrive in environments where infrastructure reliability and efficiency directly shape how quickly research reaches millions of users.

What you'll do

GPU Cluster & Infrastructure:

  • Own our H200 GPU cluster end to end: Kubernetes and Slurm for training and inference workloads, with multi-tenant scheduling, quotas, and resource isolation

  • Keep large distributed training runs healthy: node health checks, NCCL and interconnect debugging, automated job recovery, and checkpoint management

  • Track and optimize GPU utilization and cost across training and inference, with dashboards and budget alerting

  • Manage infrastructure-as-code and provisioning for GPU environments

  • Define and monitor SLIs/SLOs for cluster availability and production model serving

Deployment & Serving:

  • Deploy LLMs to production using vLLM or SGLang, with CI/CD, model versioning, and safe rollouts and rollbacks

  • Monitor serving latency, throughput, errors, and cost, and act on regressions

ML Acceleration:

  • Profile training and inference end to end (PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute) to find and remove bottlenecks

  • Improve training throughput and MFU: parallelism strategies (FSDP, tensor and pipeline parallelism), communication/compute overlap, mixed precision and FP8, activation checkpointing, torch.compile

  • Optimize inference: quantization (FP8, INT8, INT4), speculative decoding, prefix caching, continuous batching, KV cache tuning, and parallelism layouts

  • Write or integrate fused and custom kernels (Triton, CUDA) where off-the-shelf implementations fall short

  • Build benchmarking tooling so every optimization ships with measured gains

Enablement & Best Practices:

  • Partner with ML engineers and researchers to make training and serving efficient by default

  • Establish best practices for using the cluster and guide teams in their adoption

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in ML infrastructure, MLOps, HPC, or platform engineering with focus on GPU workloads

  • Hands-on experience operating multi-node GPU clusters with Kubernetes and/or Slurm, including debugging hardware, networking (NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE), and job failures

  • Production experience deploying and optimizing LLM inference with vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM

  • Proven track record of profiling and accelerating GPU workloads, with measured results in throughput, latency, MFU, or cost

  • Solid understanding of monitoring and observability for GPU systems (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, or similar)

  • Naturally curious with a track record of proactively identifying and implementing improvements

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience writing custom kernels in Triton or CUDA, and familiarity with fused kernels such as FlashAttention

  • Performance tuning of distributed training frameworks: FSDP, Megatron-LM, or DeepSpeed

  • Experience with low-precision training and inference (**FP8**, INT4) and model compression for production deployment

  • Deep knowledge of GPU architectures: memory hierarchy, tensor cores, roofline analysis

  • Experience with multi-tenant GPU scheduling and fair-share resource allocation

  • Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, or Triton

What we offer

  • Critical infrastructure ownership for high-impact AI projects that are strategically vital to the company, with direct visibility to senior leadership including the CEO

  • State-of-the-art GPU infrastructure: H200 fleet, vLLM serving stack, and the freedom to optimize it end to end

  • Expert ML team who have released top Hugging Face models, published at NeurIPS, and built production systems that will run on your infrastructure

  • Significant autonomy in choosing tools and shaping our infrastructure and performance strategy

  • Modern tooling: Latest ML frameworks, coding assistants, best-in-class development environment

  • Hybrid work model with our Amsterdam office - home to the AI House, bringing together 200+ AI professionals through events and collaborations

  • Competitive compensation, top-spec MacBook Pro, and an environment genuinely built for professional growth and learning

If you're excited to own the GPU infrastructure behind cutting-edge LLMs and make every training run and every request faster, let's talk.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.
